question: Alarmel Valli and Rukmini Devi Arundale are associated with which of the following styles of Indian Dances?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharatanatyam**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Bharatanatyam is one of the oldest classical dance forms of India, which originated in the temples of Tamil Nadu.
 
• It is known for its fixed upper torso, bent legs, and intricate footwork combined with expressive hand gestures and facial expressions.
 
• Alarmel Valli and Rukmini Devi Arundale are renowned exponents of Bharatanatyam, contributing significantly to its popularization and revival.
 
• Bharatanatyam performances are usually accompanied by classical Carnatic music and involve a repertoire of both abstract dance and expressive dance narratives.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kathakali**

 
 
• Kathakali is a classical Indian dance form that originated in Kerala.
 
• It is known for its elaborate costumes, detailed gestures, and well-defined body movements presented in the form of drama.
 
• Kathakali is traditionally performed by male dancers, even for female roles.
 
 
 
• **Kathak**
 
 
• Kathak is one of the eight major forms of Indian classical dance.
 
• It originated from Northern India and is characterized by intricate footwork and spins, as well as the use of expressive gestures and facial expressions.
 
• Kathak dancers narrate stories through their dance, which are often taken from Indian epics.
 
 
 
• **Kuchipudi**
 
 
• Kuchipudi is a classical dance form from Andhra Pradesh, India.
 
• It involves fast rhythmic footwork, sculpturesque body movements, and dramatic characterization.
 
• Like Bharatanatyam, Kuchipudi performances also include both pure dance and expressive dance segments.
